problem: Owner's real-device screenshot (2026-09-29 08:25:12, i.e. BEFORE the 08:28:26 startChallenge deploy) showed the ¥39.90 paywall for a CHALLENGE the owner had ALREADY PAID for. The entry-flow resume fix (441d5a5) addresses the routing, but the paywall/order path had no 'already owned' guard: createOrder's only duplicate check (antiFraud.checkDuplicateOrder) blocks a repeat within a 30-minute window only, so an older paid unlock could still be purchased AGAIN → double-charge risk on one-time unlock SKUs.
